extracted.name: French 75
extracted.description: This French 75 cocktail is perfect for celebrations! Made with gin, simple syrup, and lemon and topped with Champagne, it's bubbly, bright, and festive. Be sure to chill the Champagne (or other dry sparkling wine) before making the recipe.
instruction_lines: In a cocktail shaker with ice, place the gin, lemon juice, and simple syrup.
Shake until chilled and strain into a Champagne flute or coupe glass.
Top with the Champagne and garnish with a lemon twist.
